1124.name: Wasteland

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

1124.objective: Speak with Layo Starstrike near the Valor's Rest graveyard of Silithus, showing him Rabine's Letter.
1124.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Speak with Layo Starstrike near the Valor's Rest graveyard of Silithus, showing him Rabine's Letter. | Rabine's Letter | Provided: | Rabine's Letter | Description | West of Un'Goro Crater, via the northwestern ridge, is a harsh wasteland - Silithus.  Few know that an ancient war was waged there between the night elves and a malign, alien power.  The evil was sealed, but now we suspect that forces work to stir this... unspeakable horror. | Seek out Layo Starstrike, one of our agents in Silithus; look for him at Valor's Rest, the final resting spot for the fallen of the wastes.  Give him this letter, and he will give you his trust accordingly. | Rewards | Experience: | 2,800 | +50 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | This is a dangerous land to be so casual, ‹class›. What brings you to the wastes of Silithus? | When you hand it in | Rabine sent you, did he? Well, consider yourself welcomed here... as much as this desolate and forsaken land can welcome someone. | I wasn't alive during the time of the great tribulations that took place here, but there are parts of this desert that might as well be eerie pictures of that forgotten past. With your help, the Cenarion Circle might be able to bring finality to a threat that was supposed to have died generations ago.

1125.name: The Spirits of Southwind

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

1125.objective: Free the spirits of 8 Tortured Druids and 8 Tortured Sentinels in Southwind Village, and then return to Layo Starstrike at the Valor's Rest graveyard of Silithus.
1125.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Free the spirits of 8 Tortured Druids and 8 Tortured Sentinels in Southwind Village, and then return to Layo Starstrike at the Valor's Rest graveyard of Silithus. | Tortured Druid slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Tortured Sentinel slain | : | 0/ | 8 | Description | To our southwest lies a tragic site - the ruins of Southwind Village.  This is where our work should begin, ‹name›. | From what we've learned, this village was once a night elf base of operations for Silithus.  It's long since overrun by the silithid hives that infest the wastes.  I can only imagine the horror of the village's initial sundering... | The tortured spirits of fallen druids and sentinels wander the ruins aimlessly.  Explore this locale, freeing the souls of these wretched beings as needed. | Rewards | Experience: | 5,650 | +100 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | Alliance or Horde, it doesn't matter - no being deserves to be trapped on this world as a tortured spirit.  The freeing of these souls will make things right, ‹name›. | When you hand it in | I had thought that maybe the huge swirling hive near the ruins of the village had played a part in its demise. It would seem that your work has proven this to be correct; the proximity of the hive poses a threat to any future work we may do here. | I thank you for your benevolence in freeing the souls of the fallen; such work is never easy, I know. When you're ready, however, I'd like to ask for your assistance once more...

1126.name: Hive in the Tower

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

1126.objective: Scale the tower of Southwind Village and locate a means to stir the silithid hive into activity.  Bring back anything unusual you may uncover when doing so to Layo Starstrike at the Valor's Rest graveyard of Silithus.
1126.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Scale the tower of Southwind Village and locate a means to stir the silithid hive into activity.  Bring back anything unusual you may uncover when doing so to Layo Starstrike at the Valor's Rest graveyard of Silithus. | Encrusted Silithid Object | Description | The hive needs to be addressed in Southwind Village, and I think I know a way to get at them.  It's been my experience that the silithid hives are very sensitive to their environment; this explains their attacks when hearing the death wails of the spirits. | The silithid are strongest in the tower - the one with the mass of wasps circling it.  Scale the tower and jostle the hive into activity.  Report back what you learn, but be careful!  If you uncover anything that might help, bring it to me. | Rewards | Experience: | 6,000 | +100 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | Well, did it work? You're still in one piece, which is good news. Did you find anything? | When you hand it in | What the... what is it? | It has the shape of a... box, maybe? It's encrusted over something fierce. Wait, there a portion here that's exposed... is that a book underneath all this gunk? | I think you've stumbled across quite the find here, ‹name›... well, at least I hope it is. Perhaps it is a journal or a log from ancient times, preserved in this shell. | I think I know a way to find out what this is.

5527.name: A Reliquary of Purity

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

5527.objective: Travel to Silithus and search for a Reliquary of Purity within the ruins of Southwind Village.  If you are able to find it, return with it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade.
5527.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Travel to Silithus and search for a Reliquary of Purity within the ruins of Southwind Village.  If you are able to find it, return with it to Rabine Saturna in Nighthaven, Moonglade. | Reliquary of Purity | Description | The first step is to find a container capable of holding an extremely corruptible substance without the handler suffering ill effects.  There is only one sort device I am aware of that could possibly contain something as vile as the Felvine: a Reliquary of Purity. | Deep in the wasteland of Silithus is the remnants of the night elf village known as Southwind.  I know one was there many, many years ago.  If we are to succeed, I need you to scour those ruins in the hopes of reclaiming it. | Rewards | Experience: | 6,600 | +100 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | A Reliquary of Purity is an artifact unto itself.  Few were ever made, and almost all of them were thought to have been lost over time. | I admit I have known about the one in Southwind for a little while now.  Honestly, with the rising turmoil in Silithus, I thought to keep our secrets just that - a secret.  To poke and prod would only cause suspicions of our enemies to rise. | Alas, the time for complacency is at an end, especially with the situation in Eldre'Thalas. | When you hand it in | Indeed, you are as resourceful as many claim. The Cenarion Circle is blessed to have you working in our stead. | With the Reliquary once more in our hands, my mind is at ease. I feel more comfortable asking you to not only face down a malfeasant demon, but also to bring back a dangerous item in the process...

6844.name: Umber, Archivist

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

6844.objective: Take the Encrusted Silithid Object to Umber - the Cenarion Circle's archivist - in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.
6844.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Take the Encrusted Silithid Object to Umber - the Cenarion Circle's archivist - in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade. | Encrusted Silithid Object | Provided: | Encrusted Silithid Object | Description | There's plenty to do here still, but I think taking this back to the Circle for analysis is key.  Trust me - the work will still be here once this is all said and done.  If it's a journal inside this sticky chitin, then the Circle would finally have a window into the past! | Take this to the Circle's archivist in Nighthaven.  His name is Umber, and the man's brilliant.  Touched, sure, but brilliant nonetheless!  Umber's salvaged tomes in far worse shape than this.  If it can be saved, he can do it. | Rewards | Experience: | 3,000 | +50 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | Why, hello there! Hrmm... | Let me be a little honest with you, friend... you smell a bit ripe. Whiffy, one might say. Now I'm not making a personal assailment of your being. I'm just saying... in the future, you may want to freshen up a little after coming in from the field. It will make those first impressions a little more positively impressionable! | Anyhoo... what can I do for you? | When you hand it in | Well great monkey toads! What have you got here? It's sort of book shaped, I guess... I'll try crack this shell on it. | Layo sent you to me from Silithus? I've only heard very hushed rumblings - which I guess aren't all that hushed when you think about it - about the horrors that are going on out there. Couple that with my lack of pleasure for anything bug-like, and you've got the recipe for me needing to stay here with the books!

7785.name: Examine the Vessel

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

7785.objective: Examine the Vessel of Rebirth and return it to Highlord Demitrian.
7785.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Examine the Vessel of Rebirth and return it to Highlord Demitrian. | Vessel of Rebirth | Provided: | Vessel of Rebirth | Description | Examine the vessel of his rebirth, mortal. It is from this that the Windseeker shall be reborn! | When you come back | Will you release him from his eternal prison? | When you hand it in | May you be protected in your crusade. May the Master bless your efforts.

7786.name: Thunderaan the Windseeker

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

7786.objective: To free Thunderaan the Windseeker from his prison, you must present the right and left halves of the Bindings of the Windseeker, 10 bars of Elementium, and the Essence of the Firelord to Highlord Demitrian in Silithus.
7786.sheetText: Quest Objectives | To free Thunderaan the Windseeker from his prison, you must present the right and left halves of the Bindings of the Windseeker, 10 bars of Elementium, and the Essence of the Firelord to Highlord Demitrian in Silithus. | 10 | Elementium Bar | Essence of the Firelord | Bindings of the Windseeker | Bindings of the Windseeker | Description | I have told you all that I know, ‹name›. It is you who must find elementium. It is you who must destroy the Firelord's corporeal form. | Do this and gain the blessing of Thunderaan. | Rewards | Experience: | 9,950 | When you come back | Bring the world to its knees if you must! | When you hand it in | Even in dreams I did not dare foresee this day. | Behold, mortal. | BEHOLD HE WHO IS OLDER THAN EXISTENCE! | BEHOLD HE WHO HAS FACED TITAN AND GOD ALIKE! | RISE MY MASTER! BREAK FROM YOUR BONDS!

7787.name: Rise, Thunderfury!

facts.Start: an item: Dormant Wind Kissed Blade
facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll
facts.giver: an item: Dormant Wind Kissed Blade

7787.objective: Present the Dormant Wind Kissed Blade to Highlord Demitrian.
7787.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Present the Dormant Wind Kissed Blade to Highlord Demitrian. | Dormant Wind Kissed Blade | Provided: | Dormant Wind Kissed Blade | Description | You have defeated the Wind Seeker. Take the dormant blade and force the lying wretch, Demitrian, to use the materials you provided for his betrayal to wake Thunderfury. | Rewards | You will receive: | Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker | Experience: | 9,950 | When you come back | <Demitrian cowers in your presence.> | When you hand it in | Please do not harm me! Take it! Take the blade! Leave Demitrian to reshape his pathetic life!

8275.name: Taking Back Silithus

facts.Side: Alliance

8275.objective: Talk to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
8275.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Talk to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. | Description | Attention, heroes of the Alliance!  The silithid menace has been left unchecked for too long.  Unfettered by any real opposition, they've been preparing all this time for a large-scale expansion. | Cenarion Circle forces are gathering in Silithus to take the fight to these wretched creatures and all able-bodied adventurers are hereby called to join us! | Don't wait until it's too late!  Aid us in the defense of Azeroth! Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold for specific instructions! | Rewards | Experience: | 2,800 | +10 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you hand it in | Excellent, a new recruit answering the call to arms against the silithid. Welcome to Cenarion Hold, ‹class›. I am pleased to see the words of our emissaries are reaching heroes of your caliber. You will find no shortage of opportunities to help us in our efforts here and I expect you'll quickly prove to be a valuable ally to our cause.

8277.name: Deadly Desert Venom

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8277.objective: Beetix Ficklespragg at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to gather 8 Stonelash Scorpid Stingers and 8 Sand Skitterer Fangs. Return to her when you have completed the task.
8277.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Beetix Ficklespragg at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to gather 8 Stonelash Scorpid Stingers and 8 Sand Skitterer Fangs. Return to her when you have completed the task. | 8 | Stonelash Scorpid Stinger | 8 | Sand Skitterer Fang | Description | Beetix Ficklespragg at your service!  My cousin Noggle makes a living gathering rare herbs for Cenarion Hold alchemists.  Or used to, anyway.  He came back from his last trip with a strong poison running though his veins. | I've managed to slow down the venom, but to fully neutralize it I need poison samples from whatever stung him. | Noggle arrived from the north, so I'd bet my shirt stonelash scorpids or sand skitterers did it.  Bring me some stingers and fangs and I'll try to make an antidote for him. | Rewards | Money: | 85 | 0 gold, 85 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 5,650 | +75 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | Are you done collecting those samples?  We could lose Noggle any minute now! | When you hand it in | Cross your fingers, friend!  Here's to hoping we can save Noggle!

8278.name: Noggle's Last Hope

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8278.objective: Beetix Ficklespragg at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to gather 3 Stonelash Pincer Stingers, 3 Stonelash Flayer Stingers and 3 Rock Stalker Fangs.
8278.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Beetix Ficklespragg at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to gather 3 Stonelash Pincer Stingers, 3 Stonelash Flayer Stingers and 3 Rock Stalker Fangs. | 3 | Stonelash Flayer Stinger | 3 | Stonelash Pincer Stinger | 3 | Rock Stalker Fang | Description | Blasted!  The antidote didn't work.  Noggle must've been stung by one of the stronger creatures in the far south. | I'm going to need you to go there and get me some more samples, ‹name›.  The good news is that since their poison is stronger I won't require as many.  The bad news is that there are more kinds of poisonous creatures crawling around the southern area so you'll have to draw from more sources. | Rewards | You will be able to choose one of these rewards: | 2 | Major Healing Potion | Major Mana Potion | Money: | 65 | 0 gold, 65 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 6,000 | +100 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | This is our last chance to save Noggle!  Hurry! | When you hand it in | Yes!  It seems to be working, Noggle is coming to.  We owe ya big time!

8279.name: The Twilight Lexicon

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8279.objective: Bring the three chapters of the Twilight Lexicon to Hermit Ortell in Silithus.
8279.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring the three chapters of the Twilight Lexicon to Hermit Ortell in Silithus. | Twilight Lexicon - Chapter 1 | Twilight Lexicon - Chapter 2 | Twilight Lexicon - Chapter 3 | Description | The Twilight's Hammer are not kind to those that leave their ranks.  They hunt me to this day like I'm some sort of beast!  Needless to say, an enemy of theirs is a friend of mine! | To decipher this Tablet I'll need the book used by their scribes to encode secret messages: the Twilight Lexicon.  It's such an important tool that they keep its three chapters in different locations!  The officers entrusted with the Lexicon are known as Twilight Keepers, look for them at the Twilight's Hammer camps. | Rewards | Money: | 90 | 0 gold, 90 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 8,300 | +100 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | Who goes there?  Oh, it's you!  Did you find all the Lexicon chapters yet? | When you hand it in | Yes! These are the parts to the book!  Let's get started then, ‹name›. | Swap every third word with words from the second chapter... then swap every other word with words from the first chapter...  Wait, did I get that backwards?

8280.name: Securing the Supply Lines

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8280.objective: Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to kill 15 Dredge Strikers.
8280.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to kill 15 Dredge Strikers. | Dredge Striker slain | : | 0/ | 15 | Description | Cenarion Hold is a location of utmost strategic importance.  I'm convinced that while we hold it our victory over the silithid is guaranteed.  Provided our influx supplies can be maintained, that is. | Desert worms have proven to be more of a threat to our supply caravans than even the silithid themselves.  Just this morning, a large shipment of morrowgrain was ravaged by a group of dredge strikers.  I need you to thin their numbers to ensure our supplies aren't jeopardized. | Rewards | Money: | 85 | 0 gold, 85 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 5,650 | +75 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | The dredge strikers are a serious threat and must be dealt with quickly! | When you hand it in | You have my sincere gratitude.  Your efforts in helping Cenarion Hold have shown true courage.

8281.name: Stepping Up Security

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8281.objective: Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to slay 20 Dredge Crushers.
8281.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to slay 20 Dredge Crushers. | Dredge Crusher slain | : | 0/ | 20 | Description | Your performance has been truly exemplary so far, ‹name›.  Our supply lines are not completely safe yet, however.  In the absence of dredge strikers, their larger southern cousins will surely move in to take their place in the north. | You'll have to kill quite a few dredge crushers to keep them at bay, but we cannot leave the safety of our supply lines to chance. | Rewards | Money: | 1 | 70 | 1 gold, 70 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 6,000 | +100 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | The dredge crushers are a serious threat and must be dealt with at once! | When you hand it in | Excellent!  You've proven to be a valuable ally in preparing for the war against the silithid.

8282.name: Noggle's Lost Satchel

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8282.objective: Retrieve Noggle's Satchel from the mountains in the south of Silithus and return it to him at Cenarion Hold.
8282.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Retrieve Noggle's Satchel from the mountains in the south of Silithus and return it to him at Cenarion Hold. | Noggle's Satchel | Description | Where am I?  Where's my bag? *gasp* I must've lost it while fleeing from Deathclasp, the giant scorpid.  In my rush to escape I walked right into a nest of stonelash flayers. | The satchel I was carrying had all sorts of rare reagents in it.  Without them, me and Beetix won't be able to make the potions that Cenarion Hold needs.  I'm too weak to get up yet, but I can make it worth your while if you bring back my reagents. | I ran into Deathclasp in the southern mountain range, behind Bronzebeard's camp. | Rewards | You will be able to choose one of these rewards: | 2 | Elixir of the Mongoose | 2 | Elixir of the Sages | Experience: | 6,200 | +100 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | Still haven't found my bag?  Well I should count my lucky stars, at least the poison's been cleansed. | When you hand it in | Yes!  You brought my satchel back.  And my rare reagents are all here!  I'll be in your debt for a long time.

8283.name: Wanted - Deathclasp, Terror of the Sands

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8283.objective: Bring Deathclasp's Pincer to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard.
8283.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring Deathclasp's Pincer to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard. | Deathclasp's Pincer | Description | The terrible scorpid, Deathclasp, is believed to have retreated to the southern mountain range in the presence of increased silithid activity.  She presents a great threat to patrols and expeditions in the southern regions.  Individuals participating in her destruction will be remunerated handsomely.  Inquire with Captain Vish Kozus, at the top of the Cenarion Hold Watchtower, regarding a reward. | Rewards | You will be able to choose one of these rewards: | Sandstrider's Mark | Black Crystal Dagger | Money: | 1 | 80 | 1 gold, 80 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 8,050 | +100 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | I'll need the creature's pincer as proof of the deed. No pincer, no reward. | When you hand it in | Excellent! With Deathclasp gone we're free to use the southern mountain range as a strategic path to circumvent the silithid hives. Your work is greatly appreciated.

8284.name: The Twilight Mystery

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8284.objective: Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to collect 8 Twilight Tablet Fragments.
8284.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to collect 8 Twilight Tablet Fragments. | 8 | Twilight Tablet Fragment | Description | A camp of Twilight's Hammer cultists once thrived northwest of here.  If you were to venture there now, you'd find the area swarming with elementals and nothing but scattered pieces of wood and canvas to mark the spot where the camp was. | I've recovered a few fragments of a clay tablet from the site, but I have too few of them to piece together anything useful.  See if you can find the remaining tablet fragments so we can shed some light into the Twilight's Hammer presence here in Silithus. | Rewards | Money: | 90 | 0 gold, 90 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 6,200 | +100 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | The ravaged camp can be found northwest of here.  Come back when you have all the fragments. | When you hand it in | Just as I suspected.  I can decipher individual words in the tablets but they appear to be devoid of any logic or meaning.  It's not unknown for Twilight's Hammer sects to use a code to hide the meaning of their texts; we'll have to go to someone who knows more about this sort of thing.

8285.name: The Deserter

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8285.objective: Take the restored tablet to Hermit Ortell in Silithus.
8285.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Take the restored tablet to Hermit Ortell in Silithus. | Restored Twilight Tablet | Provided: | Restored Twilight Tablet | Description | There are rumors of a Twilight's Hammer member called Ortell having deserted his sect.  Word has it he hid in the mountains south of Southwind Village, where he lives as a hermit.  Perhaps you can enlist his help in deciphering the tablet. | Take the restored tablet with you and seek out Ortell. | Rewards | Experience: | 4,800 | +50 reputation with Cenarion Circle | 0 reputation with Leatherworking - Tribal | When you come back | You!  How did you find me?  Who are you?  You weren't followed, were you?  Speak! | When you hand it in | I see you're familiar with my old organization.  You must be with Cenarion Hold. | You seek information to use against them?  Come closer, perhaps we can be of mutual assistance.

8287.name: A Terrible Purpose

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8287.objective: Take the Decoded Tablet Parchment to Commander Mar'alith.
8287.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Take the Decoded Tablet Parchment to Commander Mar'alith. | Decoded Tablet Transcription | Provided: | Decoded Tablet Transcription | Description | Ok, here we are... a pretty valuable chunk of information, I must say!  I've seen the Cenarion Circle forces arrive at Silithus.  They plan to drive the Twilight's Hammer out, don't they?  This will help. | Take this parchment to their leader, Commander Mar'alith.  Soon the Twilight's Hammer will be vanquished and I will be outside their grasp for good! | Rewards | Money: | 1 | 80 | 1 gold, 80 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 6,600 | +100 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | What is this you bring to me, ‹name›? | When you hand it in | This is very interesting information indeed, ‹name›.  This sheds some light on the presence of the Twilight's Hammer in Silithus and will undoubtedly help us in our struggle against them.  Your efforts will be handsomely rewarded, ‹class›.

8304.name: Dearest Natalia

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8304.objective: Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to question the inhabitants of Bronzebeard's Encampment. You will find Bronzebeard's Encampment south of Cenarion Hold. Once you have gathered the requested information, return to Commander Mar'alith.
8304.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to question the inhabitants of Bronzebeard's Encampment. You will find Bronzebeard's Encampment south of Cenarion Hold. | Once you have gathered the requested information, return to Commander Mar'alith. | Frankal Questioned | Rutgar Questioned | Description | My dear Natalia has gone missing. | Truth be told, she had been acting strangely for weeks leading up to her disappearance. I had caught her talking to herself when no one was around on more than one occasion. She was adamant that everything was ok and that she must be allowed to continue her research. | She was last seen heading to Bronzebeard's camp to the south. | My soldiers are spread too thin, ‹name›. I need you to go to Bronzebeard's camp and question those dwarves. | Rewards | Experience: | 6,600 | +100 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | Waste no time, ‹name›! | When you hand it in | <Commander Mar'alith lowers his head in contemplation.> | Whether she is alive or dead, I must do what is right. She must be found. Alas, I am bound by duty to this outpost. Will you help me once more, ‹name›?

8306.name: Into The Maw of Madness

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8306.objective: Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to find his beloved Natalia. The information that you gathered points to Hive'Regal in the south as being the area in which you may find Mistress Natalia Mar'alith. Do not forget to visit the dwarves at Bronzebeard's camp before venturing into the hive. They might have some additional work and advice for you. And ‹name›, remember the Commander's words: "Do what you must..."
requirements: The Fate of Mistress Natalia Mar'alith
8306.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to find his beloved Natalia. The information that you gathered points to Hive'Regal in the south as being the area in which you may find Mistress Natalia Mar'alith. | Do not forget to visit the dwarves at Bronzebeard's camp before venturing into the hive. They might have some additional work and advice for you. | And ‹name›, remember the Commander's words: "Do what you must..." | The Fate of Mistress Natalia Mar'alith | Description | I need you to venture into Hive'Regal and find what became of my dearest Natalia, ‹name›. This will be no easy task for you. Before you dive headlong into the maw of madness, make sure that you go back and speak with those dwarves. They might be able to give you some tips on dealing with the silithid that inhabit that hive. | And ‹name›, if she truly is as mad as they say... do what you must. | <Commander Mar'alith turns away from you.> | Rewards | You will receive: | Corrupted Blackwood Staff | Money: | 2 | 70 | 2 gold, 70 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 9,950 | +200 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | Natalia? | When you hand it in | <Commander Mar'alith clutches at his chest.> | C'Thun? WHAT is the meaning of all this? What is C'Thun? How could this fiend have turned my sweet Natalia into the monster that you described?

8307.name: Desert Recipe

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8307.objective: Look for information about cooking Sandworm Meat at the Twilight's Hammer camp west of Cenarion Hold.
8307.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Look for information about cooking Sandworm Meat at the Twilight's Hammer camp west of Cenarion Hold. | Description | Adapting to life in the desert has been difficult to say the least.  Not only do I miss the birds and trees of Auberdine but our food selection is severely limited by this arid environment.  I'm trying to learn about desert herbs, but there aren't many. | I've seen Twilight's Hammer groups from the camp west of here hunt sandworms for food.  Sandworm meat is so bitter though, I can't imagine how they make it palatable.  Keep your eyes open if you go to their camp and let me know if you learn anything. | Rewards | Experience: | 3,000 | +10 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you hand it in | This book contains several common recipes and a few unusual ones. After browsing through it for a few seconds you spot a recipe that involves sandworm meat.

8308.name: Brann Bronzebeard's Lost Letter

facts.Start: an item: Brann Bronzebeard's Lost Letter
facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll
facts.giver: an item: Brann Bronzebeard's Lost Letter

8308.objective: Take Brann Bronzebeard's Letter to Bronzebeard's Encampment in southern Silithus.
8308.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Take Brann Bronzebeard's Letter to Bronzebeard's Encampment in southern Silithus. | Brann Bronzebeard's Lost Letter | Provided: | Brann Bronzebeard's Lost Letter | Description | To Whom It May Concern: | If you're reading this, I'm either dead or soon to be dead. It's hard to say. Most of the crew is dead anyhow. | Found information about a Titan. Great battle between him and an Old God. Yes, a bona fide Old God. Found ancient tunnel leading to Ahn'Qiraj. Taking it. | Take this letter to my old camp. Make sure my monkey is getting adequate food, water, and hugs. | -Brann Bronzebeard, Explorer Extreme | P.S. Watch out for crazy Old God worshipping night elf. | Rewards | You will receive: | Brann's Trusty Pick | Experience: | 8,300 | +100 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | Oh dear. | When you hand it in | Well this explains a lot. If you ever find a way into Ahn'Qiraj, keep an eye out for ol' Brann. I'm afraid that he'll be powerless without his monkey.

8309.name: Glyph Chasing

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8309.objective: Rutgar Glyphshaper at Bronzebeard's Encampment in Silithus wants you to venture to Hive'Ashi, Hive'Zora, and Hive'Regal and recover Glyphed Rubbings from the Glyphed Crystals of each hive. Use the Geologist's Transcription Kit to make a reasonable facsimile of the ancient glyphs. Return to Rutgar Glyphshaper when you complete this task.
8309.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Rutgar Glyphshaper at Bronzebeard's Encampment in Silithus wants you to venture to Hive'Ashi, Hive'Zora, and Hive'Regal and recover Glyphed Rubbings from the Glyphed Crystals of each hive. | Use the Geologist's Transcription Kit to make a reasonable facsimile of the ancient glyphs. Return to Rutgar Glyphshaper when you complete this task. | Hive'Ashi Rubbing | Hive'Zora Rubbing | Hive'Regal Rubbing | Geologist's Transcription Kit | Provided: | Geologist's Transcription Kit | Description | After our initial foray into the hives and Mistress Mar'alith's subsequent madness the three hives have been spewing out bugs! The increased activity might be tied into the glyphs covering those strange crystals. | We must get a rubbing from crystals in all three hives. If we can get those rubbings, we might be able to make sense of this madness. | Take this transcription set  and hit those hives, ‹name›. Don't come back until you've gotten copies from each hive. | Rewards | Money: | 2 | 70 | 2 gold, 70 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 8,300 | +100 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | If you find some crazy night elf lass in one of the hives, be sure to give her a kick in the duff for us. | When you hand it in | I can't make heads or tails of these glyphs. I've never seen anything like it! I hope Frankal's research can shed some light on this mess.

8310.name: Breaking the Code

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8310.objective: Frankal Stonebridge at Bronzebeard's Encampment in Silithus wants you to recover a Hive'Zora Silithid Brain, Hive'Ashi Silithid Brain, and a Hive'Regal Silithid Brain. Return to Frankal when you have completed this task.
8310.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Frankal Stonebridge at Bronzebeard's Encampment in Silithus wants you to recover a Hive'Zora Silithid Brain, Hive'Ashi Silithid Brain, and a Hive'Regal Silithid Brain. Return to Frankal when you have completed this task. | Hive'Ashi Silithid Brain | Hive'Zora Silithid Brain | Hive'Regal Silithid Brain | Description | I think I can formulate an elixir that will allow us to more readily decipher the glyphs and language of the silithid and Qiraji! What do I need? Glad you asked! I need brains! More specifically, a brain from each silithid type that inhabit the hives. Bring me brains and Rutgar's work might not be for naught. | Rewards | Money: | 2 | 70 | 2 gold, 70 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 8,300 | +100 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | Go play with the monkey, kid. I don't have time for this. | When you hand it in | Outstanding! Don't wander off too far, kid. We might need you to take on another task or two.

8313.name: Sharing the Knowledge

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8313.objective: Bring the Torn Recipe Page to Calandrath at the inn in Cenarion Hold.
8313.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring the Torn Recipe Page to Calandrath at the inn in Cenarion Hold. | Torn Recipe Page | Provided: | Torn Recipe Page | Description | While the recipe for cooking sandworm meat is legible, it contains references to herbs and spices you've never heard of.  Calandrath might have enough knowledge of the plants that grow in the desert to make sense of it. | Rewards | You will learn: | Smoked Desert Dumplings | Money: | 85 | 0 gold, 85 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 6,000 | +50 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | Did you learn the recipe?  You won't keep it to yourself, I hope! | When you hand it in | Let's have a look at that... | This seems simple enough.  They have their own names for some of the herbs, but those are simple enough to figure out.  Here, let me show you!

8314.name: Unraveling the Mystery

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8314.objective: Rutgar Glyphshaper at Bronzebeard's Encampment wants you to deliver the Glyphed Crystal Prism to Geologist Larksbane at the Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
8314.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Rutgar Glyphshaper at Bronzebeard's Encampment wants you to deliver the Glyphed Crystal Prism to Geologist Larksbane at the Cenarion Hold in Silithus. | Glyphed Crystal Prism | Provided: | Glyphed Crystal Prism | Description | We're on the verge of a breakthrough, ‹name›! The rubbings you recovered have allowed us to recreate the glyphs on this crystalline prism. They are apparently a means for the Qiraji and other unknown entities to communicate various messages to the silithid. | Unfortunately, that is all we could get out of the glyphs. We need to find a way to unlock the messages hidden within the crystals. | Take the glyphed crystal prism to Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold.  She might be able to help. | Rewards | Experience: | 4,950 | +75 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | Oh my! What do you have there, ‹name›? | When you hand it in | The reason the dwarves could not decipher the glyphs is because there is nothing to decipher. The shifting outer layer of the prism must properly align with the inner crystal's markings in order for the message to be transmitted. Clever... | While we should be able to translate this data, we must first unlock the code. There is only one clue on the surface of the prism - assuming the rubbings were transferred correctly - and it looks grim.

8315.name: The Calling

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8315.objective: Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to recover the Crystal Unlocking Mechanism from the Qiraji Emissary. You have been instructed to take the Glyphs of Calling to the Bones of Grakkarond, south of Cenarion Hold, and draw them in the sand. Should the Qiraji Emissary appear, slay it and recover the Crystal Unlocking Mechanism. Return to Geologist Larksbane if you succeed. Assemble an army for this task, ‹name›!
8315.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to recover the Crystal Unlocking Mechanism from the Qiraji Emissary. | You have been instructed to take the Glyphs of Calling to the Bones of Grakkarond, south of Cenarion Hold, and draw them in the sand. Should the Qiraji Emissary appear, slay it and recover the Crystal Unlocking Mechanism. Return to Geologist Larksbane if you succeed. | Assemble an army for this task, ‹name›! | Crystal Unlocking Mechanism | Provided: | Glyphs of Calling | Description | The glyphs illustrate an emissary of the Qiraji meeting with three silithid at the bones of a large dragon. Above the glyphs is what I can only assume to be a code of some sort. This code might very well be the key to summoning the emissary. | I will create a copy of the glyph code that you must use in the sand at the Bones of Grakkarond. If I am right, the Overlords will come thinking that new data is ready for transmission. Strike them down and confront the emissary. He holds the key to the crystals... | Rewards | Experience: | 9,950 | +200 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | You must take the opportunity as it presents itself and strike! | When you hand it in | I hold 20,000 years of history in my hands, ‹name›!

8317.name: Kitchen Assistance

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8317.objective: Calandrath at Cenarion Hold needs a batch of 10 Smoked Desert Dumplings.
8317.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Calandrath at Cenarion Hold needs a batch of 10 Smoked Desert Dumplings. | 10 | Smoked Desert Dumplings | Description | That recipe sure will come in handy.  I'd better get to work so I can have some smoked desert dumplings ready for today.  I could use a hand in making some, I'll make it worth your while. | Rewards | Money: | 1 | 70 | 1 gold, 70 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 3,000 | +50 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | How are those dumplings coming along? | When you hand it in | Excellent! You're a life saver. These dumplings turned out to be quite good. Didn't really expect such good taste from the Twilight's Hammer.

8318.name: Secret Communication

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8318.objective: Bring 10 Encrypted Twilight Texts to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
8318.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring 10 Encrypted Twilight Texts to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold. | 10 | Encrypted Twilight Text | Description | Some of the Twilight's Hammer cultists carry around little papers with gibberish written on them.  I want you to bring me a stack of them, ‹class›. | I can't figure out what the gibberish means, but that's not the point!  These papers are how their different groups communicate secretly.  The more texts we take out of circulation, the less they can communicate! | Rewards | Money: | 1 | 80 | 1 gold, 80 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 6,600 | +100 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | Did you bring me some texts? | When you hand it in | Excellent!  I'll stash these away, maybe they'll be useful later.

8319.name: Encrypted Twilight Texts

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8319.sheetText: Quest Objectives | 10 | Encrypted Twilight Text | When you come back | Keep bringing me texts.  We'll soon force the Twilight's Hammer out of Silithus. | When you hand it in | Excellent work!  I'll put a good word in for you.

8320.name: Twilight Geolords

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8320.objective: Kill 10 Twilight Geolords, then return to Huum Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
8320.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Kill 10 Twilight Geolords, then return to Huum Wildmane in Cenarion Hold. | Twilight Geolord slain | : | 0/ | 10 | Description | The Twilight's Hammer, an insane cult bent on destruction, set up camps in Silithus and perform rituals day and night.  We do not yet know their plans, but we do think they are somehow linked to the pulsing red crystals spread across the desert. | Although their mystery may one day be solved, we must first deal with their immediate threat.  Go to their camps to the west and seek out Twilight geolords.  They are the heads of these serpents; that is where we must strike! | Rewards | Money: | 90 | 0 gold, 90 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 6,600 | +100 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | Enter the desert and find the Twilight geolords, ‹name›. Return to me after they are slain. | When you hand it in | That was a task well performed, ‹name›.  Your slaying of the Twilight geolords must have dealt a grievous blow to the cult.  Let us hope their plans are slowed...

8321.name: Vyral the Vile

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8321.objective: Bring Vyral's Signet Ring to Huum Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
8321.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring Vyral's Signet Ring to Huum Wildmane in Cenarion Hold. | Vyral's Signet Ring | Description | We have discovered another base of operations for the Twilight's Hammer.  It is called Twilight's Run; it is a cave tucked in the northeast corner of Silithus.  The local leader of the cult, Vyral the Vile, haunts that cave - it is he who you must next defeat.  When you have done this, bring me his signet ring. | Fortune to you, ‹name›.  The horrors of Twilight's Run are formidable indeed. | Rewards | You will be able to choose one of these rewards: | Desert Wind Gauntlets | Sunprism Pendant | Money: | 90 | 0 gold, 90 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 6,600 | +150 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | ‹name›, have you yet defeated Vyral the Vile?  Do you have his signet ring? | When you hand it in | You've done it!  Vyral is killed!  This can only mean doom for the Twilight Hammer's operations in Silithus. There may be more of them scurrying about, but the blow you dealt to the cult today is one from which they will not easily recover.

8323.name: True Believers

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8323.objective: Hermit Ortell wants you to bring him 10 Encrypted Twilight Texts
8323.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Hermit Ortell wants you to bring him 10 Encrypted Twilight Texts | 10 | Encrypted Twilight Text | Description | Now that I have the Twilight Lexicon in my possession, there is a small favor I'd like to ask of you. | My former organization has a secret encoded bulletin they circulate on a monthly basis. | If they make any progress searching for me or if they call off the search, word will be published on the True Believer. | Although this information is obviously valuable to me, the publication contains other useful information that I can share.  Bring me any encoded texts you find on Twilight's Hammer members. | Rewards | Money: | 90 | 0 gold, 90 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 6,400 | When you come back | Did you find any encrypted texts?  I'm quite curious to read this month's True Believer. | When you hand it in | Excellent!  I will get to decoding these as soon as possible.  If I find anything of interest I'll find some way to get the information to you.

8324.name: Still Believing

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8324.sheetText: Quest Objectives | 10 | Encrypted Twilight Text | Rewards | Money: | 45 | 0 gold, 45 silver, 0 copper | When you come back | Find any more encrypted texts? Bring me a good batch of them, this decoding work takes some time. | When you hand it in | Excellent!  I can't wait to read these. Please do keep bringing the encrypted texts here if you find them.

8331.name: Aurel Goldleaf

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8331.objective: Speak with Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.
8331.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Speak with Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold. | Description | ‹name›, although we had hoped the Twilight's Hammer's operations in Silithus were slowing... we were, regrettably, mistaken.  Through continued forays against the cult, we have learned that an even darker power, the Abyssal Council, controls the Hammer through the arcane wind stones dotted amongst the cult's camps.  Your next action, ‹name›, will be against the Abyssal Council. | Speak with the craftsman Aurel Goldleaf, in the eastern section of Cenarion Hold.  Her skill will be needed for this next gambit. | Rewards | Experience: | 650 | +25 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you hand it in | ‹name›, good day. I was told you will pit yourself against the Abyssal Council? If that is so, then listen closely to my next words...

8332.name: Dukes of the Council

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8332.objective: Bring 1 Large Brilliant Shard and 3 Abyssal Crests to Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.
8332.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring 1 Large Brilliant Shard and 3 Abyssal Crests to Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold. | Large Brilliant Shard | 3 | Abyssal Crest | Description | We think it is possible to use a wind stone to ambush a duke of the Abyssal Council.  To do this, however, one must commune through the wind stone, and convince the council you are a middle ranked leader of the Twilight's Hammer. | Such a gambit requires a replica of the cult's medallion of station.  I can create the medallion, but I will need a large brilliant shard, and crests worn by the Abyssal Templar. | Bring these to me and I will do the rest. | Rewards | You will receive: | Twilight Cultist Medallion of Station | Experience: | 6,600 | +75 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | Do you have the shard and the crests, ‹name›? I will need them to make the twilight cultist's medallion of station. | When you hand it in | Ah, very good. I've been working on the medallion - now with these last ingredients, I'll be done in just a few moments... | There we are. Here is the medallion, ‹name›. | You'll need to wear this when you activate one of the Twilight's Hammer's wind stones. Put this on, along with the rest of the twilight trappings, and the Abyssal Council will see you as one of their cultist underlings.

8333.name: Medallion of Station

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8333.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Large Brilliant Shard | 3 | Abyssal Crest | Rewards | You will receive: | Twilight Cultist Medallion of Station | Experience: | 6,600 | When you come back | If you need another Twilight cultist's medallion of station, then I am happy to oblige. I will, however, need another brilliant shard and some abyssal crests... | When you hand it in | Here you are, ‹name›. One more Twilight medallion of station. Use it well, and I wish you luck against the Abyssal Council!

8341.name: Lords of the Council

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8341.objective: Bring 5 Large Brilliant Shards and 3 Abyssal Signets to Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.
8341.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring 5 Large Brilliant Shards and 3 Abyssal Signets to Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold. | 5 | Large Brilliant Shard | 3 | Abyssal Signet | Description | Lords of the Abyssal Council can only be summoned through the greater wind stones, and only the top ranking members of the Twilight's Council may speak to them.  But... I have found a way to upgrade your disguise and fool the Abyssal Lords! | The disguise calls for a ring of lordship, worn only by the highest members of the cult.  I will craft one for you if you can bring me large brilliant shards and abyssal signets. | Rewards | You will receive: | Twilight Cultist Ring of Lordship | Experience: | 6,600 | +100 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | Do you have the shards and the signets, ‹name›? I will need them to create the ring of lordship. | When you hand it in | Thanks. Just one moment and I'll have that ring ready for you... | There it is. Now you're ready. | Be sure to wear this ring, along with a medallion of station and the rest of the twilight trappings, when you activate a greater wind stone. Do that, and the Abyssal Council will think you one of their servants. Then, perhaps you can lure one into an ambush!

8342.name: Twilight Ring of Lordship

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8342.sheetText: Quest Objectives | 3 | Abyssal Signet | 5 | Large Brilliant Shard | Rewards | You will receive: | Twilight Cultist Ring of Lordship | When you come back | ‹name›, if you plan to go after the Abyssal High Council again, then you'll need another Twilight ring of lordship. Bring me more shards and signets and I'll make one for you. | When you hand it in | Ah, I see your convictions are strong. Not many will face that council of fiends! | Here's your ring, ‹name›. May your will, and your fortune, stand firm.

8343.name: Goldleaf's Discovery

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8343.objective: Speak with Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold.
8343.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Speak with Aurel Goldleaf in Cenarion Hold. | Description | ‹name›, Aurel Goldleaf thinks she's found a way to summon and defeat a ruling member of the Abyssal Council!  Such a task will be dangerous, but you have earned great respect amongst the Cenarion Circle.  We know that if anyone can do it, you can. | May fortune go with you, ‹name›.  Speak with Aurel when you are ready. | Rewards | Experience: | 650 | +25 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you hand it in | What Huum says is true. I believe I know how to summon a lord of the Abyssal Council! Listen on, and I will explain...

8348.name: Signet of the Dukes

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8348.objective: Bring the Abyssal Signet to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
8348.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring the Abyssal Signet to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold. | Abyssal Signet | Description | Huum tells me you've figured out how to summon the Abyssal Dukes!  That's quite an accomplishment. | You know what else would be quite the accomplishment?  Smashing up one of those things really good.  That'll cause an impression on their underlings, if you know what I mean.  Bring back its signet as proof of the deed. | Rewards | You will receive: | Sack of Spoils | Money: | 1 | 80 | 1 gold, 80 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 8,300 | +150 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | How did it go with the Abyssal Duke? Did it hit hard? | When you hand it in | I knew you were a tough ‹class› the minute I saw you walk into Cenarion Hold. Keep it up!

8349.name: Bor Wildmane

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8349.objective: Speak with Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
8349.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Speak with Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold. | Description | Now that you have a medallion and can summon an Abyssal Duke, speak with Bor Wildmane.  He will set you on a task against the Abyssal Council. | Good luck, ‹name›.  And if you ever need more medallions, return to me. | Rewards | Experience: | 650 | +25 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you hand it in | Good to see you again, ‹class›! So you had a medallion made? Good -- you'll need that for your next quest...

8351.name: Bor Wishes to Speak

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8351.objective: Speak with Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
8351.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Speak with Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold. | Description | Now that you can disguise yourself as a ruling member of the Twilight Council, I am certain Bor Wildmane will want to speak with you.  Go see him, and prepare yourself for a very difficult mission... | Rewards | Experience: | 650 | +25 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you hand it in | Yes, that's right, ‹name›. I have a very tough task ahead...

8352.name: Scepter of the Council

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8352.objective: Bring an Abyssal Scepter to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
8352.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bring an Abyssal Scepter to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold. | Abyssal Scepter | Description | Huum and I were just talking about you.  He tells me you're just about ready to try your hand at fighting an Abyssal Lord! | I must tell you this is a very dangerous endeavor.  You'd better bring backup.  And I don't mean one or two of your friends, I'm talking about a top-notch, battle-ready fighting force.  If your friends are as good as you, you might even defeat it! | If you do - and I'll want evidence, as always - I'll give you a truly great reward. | Rewards | You will receive: | Chest of Spoils | Money: | 2 | 70 | 2 gold, 70 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 9,950 | +200 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | Well, how did it go? I'd do anything to leave my post and wrestle one of those things myself! | When you hand it in | You... you did it! You did it, ‹name›! Here! Take this. It's the biggest chest we had lying around and I filled it with some of the best stuff we found.

8361.name: Abyssal Contacts

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8361.objective: Bor Wildmane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to destroy an Abyssal Templar and bring him an Abyssal Crest as proof of the deed.
8361.sheetText: Quest Objectives | Bor Wildmane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus wants you to destroy an Abyssal Templar and bring him an Abyssal Crest as proof of the deed. | Abyssal Crest | Description | We've seen the Twilight's Hammer cultists performing rituals to summon powerful elemental nobles.  We don't know if these are the beings the cultists worship or if they act as intermediaries to even more powerful forces.  One thing is for sure: they are receiving orders from these elementals. | I want you to find a way to contact an Abyssal Templar and give it a proper beating!  Nothing throws the troops in disarray like taking out the chain of command.  Bring back proof while you're at it. | Rewards | You will receive: | Bag of Spoils | Money: | 90 | 0 gold, 90 silver, 0 copper | Experience: | 6,600 | +100 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | Did you finish the job? | When you hand it in | Hah! You did it, ‹name›! The Twilight's Hammer will soon be crushed!

8362.name: Abyssal Crests

facts.Side: Human, Orc, Dwarf, Night Elf, Undead, Tauren, Gnome, Troll

8362.sheetText: Quest Objectives | 3 | Abyssal Crest | Rewards | You will receive: | Bag of Spoils | +50 reputation with Cenarion Circle | When you come back | You've proved you can handle yourself in a fight, ‹name›. Let's keep the pressure up on the Twilight's Hammer. Go fight some more Abyssal Templars, I'll reward you with some of the stuff Huum and I have found in battle. | When you hand it in | You've done well! That's less Templars for me to worry about. | Here you go, ‹name›. Hope there's something useful in there for you.

8363.name: Abyssal Signets
